sloka: तव विश्रमहेतोश्च तथैषां रथवाजिनाम् ।रौद्रं वर्जयता खेदं क्षमं कृतमिदं मया ।। ६.१०६.२१ ।।
transliteration: tava viśramahetośca tathaiṣāṁ rathavājinām ।raudraṁ varjayatā khedaṁ kṣamaṁ kṛtamidaṁ mayā ।। 6.106.21 ।।

translations.english: "The reason for retreating in this way is to give you rest and relieve the horses from the terrible feat and fatigue. I deserve to be excused for this action."
